{{Quote|An Imperial Officer, Major Jotil Denive, working for the Imperial Security Bureau wishes to come over to the Alliance. You will go to Bela Vistal and create a diversion so that he can take a shuttle to a meeting with one of our officers.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:OD" />}}
'''Jotil Denive''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] and [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] who later defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:OD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jotil Denive was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jotil Denive was mentioned in the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:OD" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
